profile.headline: Software Engineer at LinkedIn
profile.summary: I am a passionate computer engineer with a specialization in machine learning looking to showcase my abilities and learn as much as possible in the field of software development.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed a support agent case creation chat bot for Dynamics 365 using Node JS and TypeScript that significantly decreases the rate of poorly-routed tickets, allowing for increased productivity and customer satisfaction through the use of machine learning and natural language processing.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description: Implemented infrastructure-level Java cloud migration to AWS that deprecated 135 high-cost data center servers and designed modular architecture for native integration with AWS servers with end-to-end testing and monitoring via Splunk, Jenkins, and Grafana.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description: Developed logic to determine if hotel rooms have free cancellation using cancellation policy information obtained through a proprietary database and propagated it through the pipeline to a search API endpoint for consumption by the UI using REST requests and JSON objects.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description: Software Development internship in which a program was developed to significantly reduce development time for General Atomics products via software systems automation.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Electrical and Computer Engineering: Intelligent Systems, Robotics, and Controls
